subject: Order form commercial terms and redlines — pricing schedule & invoicing cadence
messages:
From: Elisabeth Hunter <elisabeth.hunter@bluearc.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure-contracts@bluearc.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Order form commercial updates (pricing / payment cadence)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal / finance at BlueArc reviewed the order form and came back with a few commercial asks before we can finalize:

- Net terms: requesting Net60 (BlueArc standard) — can Redwood agree?
- Pricing schedule: we need a clear per-seat / per-token tier table in the order form; the current attached XLS is missing the annualized row for committed usage.
- Minimum commit: request to reduce the first-year commitment by 30% for the onboarding period.
- Invoice routing: we send PO and need invoices to route to billing@bluearc-payments.com (please include as billing contact).
- Taxes: BlueArc will withhold VAT where applicable and will need a tax residency certificate attached.

I'm attaching the BlueArc amendment request with markup. Can you share an internal point of contact to coordinate redlines (legal + finance)? We need this wrapped by EoQ on our side.

Attachments: [BlueArc_Amendment_Request.pdf (1.2 MB)]

Thanks —
Elisabeth Hunter
Sr. Procurement Manager
BlueArc, Inc.
elisabeth.hunter@bluearc.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elisabeth Hunter <elisabeth.hunter@bluearc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form commercial updates (pricing / payment cadence)

Hi Elisabeth —

Appreciate the clear list. I'm looping in Marissa (finance) and Ben (sales ops / commercial legal) to drive the redline response. Quick confirmations from our side up front:

- We typically run Net30 on hosted agreements; Net60 is outside standard but we can discuss a middle ground (Net45 + invoice-triggered compliance checks).
- We can produce a per-tier annualized pricing row — Marissa will attach the updated pricing schedule.
- Minimum commit: we can consider a ramp / phased commit for year 1; need to know the exact %-reduction you propose and whether you want the reduced amount refundable or applied as credit.
- Billing contact: we'll add billing@bluearc-payments.com to invoice routing.
- Taxes: we will accept tax residency certificates; please send the cert and we will update the order form appendix.

Ben / Marissa — Elisabeth attached BlueArc_Amendment_Request.pdf with their redline. Can you: 1) produce an internal redline of our order form (tracked changes), 2) propose a recommendation for net terms (Net30/Net45 compromise), and 3) confirm how we treat VAT/withholding on the invoice? Goal: have a single doc back to BlueArc within 48 hours.

I'll take lead on the commercial tradeoffs; Marissa, please advise on cashflow impact for Net45 vs Net60 and whether we can accept the onboarding ramp. Ben, please flag any language that will need legal/contract escalation.

Thanks —
Karthik
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elisabeth Hunter <elisabeth.hunter@bluearc.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Order form commercial updates (pricing / payment cadence)

Karthik / Ben / Elisabeth —

Quick finance notes after reviewing BlueArc's asks and our revenue / collections constraints:

- Net terms: Net45 is acceptable for a deal at this scale (DA-4821) with the following conditions: 1) purchase order must be received before the first invoice, 2) we require a billing contact on the PO and 3) Redwood reserves the right to require a payment guarantee (credit card on file or escrow) if the account exceeds $1.2M ARR.
- Invoicing cadence: Redwood will issue monthly invoices for actual usage against committed credits. For the onboarding period (first 90 days) we can issue pro-rated invoices reflecting the reduced commit.
- Minimum commit: finance is OK with a phased-year structure: Year 1 = 70% of contracted commit, Year 2 = 100% (with rollback language if actual usage < 50% for two consecutive quarters). Need explicit refund vs credit preference from BlueArc.
- Taxes: we will invoice gross and list taxes separately. If BlueArc withholds VAT, we need an official statement and a tax residency certificate to support tax treatment. We can include a tax appendix referencing residency evidence.

I've attached a revised pricing schedule (pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx) and flagged the billing contact on the appendix. Ben — I've left comments where I think contractual language is needed to operationalize Net45 and escrow triggers.

Attachments: [pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx (22 KB)]

—Marissa
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elisabeth Hunter <elisabeth.hunter@bluearc.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Order form commercial updates (pricing / payment cadence)

Elisabeth —

Thanks for the amendment and the clear list; appreciate the flexibility. I reviewed BlueArc's markup and Karthik / Marissa's notes and prepared a tracked redline of Redwood's order form (OrderForm_BlueArc_v3_redlines.docx). Summary of key commercial/legal positions in that draft:

1) Net terms — Proposed compromise: Net45. Rationale: balances BlueArc cash flow needs while keeping Redwood's DSO reasonable. Clause added: "Net45 subject to receipt of PO; Redwood reserves right to require additional credit support for accounts exceeding $1.2M ARR."

2) Minimum commit — We accept a 30% reduction in year-1 commit (phrased as "phased commitment"), with the remainder applied as non-refundable credits that roll forward to year 2 if unused. We added an optional refundable-cash clause (customer-selected checkbox) — BlueArc should indicate preference.

3) Pricing schedule — Inserted an annualized row for committed usage and clarified per-token consumption tiers; see table A-1 in the redline.

4) Taxes & withholding — We will invoice gross and list taxes as separate line items. For withholding, we added an exhibit that requires BlueArc to provide formal government documentation supporting withholding and an indemnity if Redwood is assessed additional tax liability.

Next steps for you: 1) Review the tracked redline and indicate whether BlueArc accepts Net45 and the non-refundable-credit model for the year-1 ramp OR prefers the refundable-cash option; 2) provide tax residency certificate and PO routing details; 3) confirm billing contact for PO and invoicing.

I've attached the redlined DOCX (no legal privilege claimed — standard commercial redline) and noted the three negotiation choices that need BlueArc action. If they want legal to talk, we can set a 30-minute sync this week.

Attachments: [OrderForm_BlueArc_v3_redlines.docx (48 KB)]

Cheers —
Ben Carter
Principal, Sales Operations & Contracts
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
